subtitle: Out Manila · Fly + cruise
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Yichang and board the Vista Harmony for a 4-night cruise through the Three Gorges, with shore excursions at Three Gorges Dam, Baidi City and more. Finish with a Chongqing city tour and a 5-star hotel stay before flying home.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 7–13 2026 to Dec 7–13 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Sanyou Cave: A scenic cave and gorge area near Yichang, visited before boarding the cruise.
placeDesc.Gezhou Dam: A large dam on the Yangtze River at Yichang, visited on a complimentary tour.
placeDesc.Xiling Gorge: The easternmost of the Three Gorges, near Yichang; the tour views its eastern section.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Dam: The huge dam on the Yangtze River, visited on a shore excursion.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Ship Lift: A giant vertical ship lift at the Three Gorges Dam, experienced during the cruise.
placeDesc.Badong Yuxian Valley: A scenic valley near Badong on the Yangtze River, visited April to October.
placeDesc.Wushan Goddess Stream: A scenic stream valley by Wushan in the Three Gorges, visited from November to March.
placeDesc.Baidi City: A hilltop old town at the head of Qutang Gorge, linked to ancient Chinese history and poetry.
placeDesc.Baiheliang Underwater Museum: A museum in Fuling that protects an ancient river-level stone ridge with inscriptions beneath the water.
placeDesc.Project 816 Site: A former secret nuclear facility in Fuling hollowed out of a mountain, now open to visitors.
placeDesc.People’s Square: A central public square in Chongqing, a stop on the city sightseeing day.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light-rail station where the train runs through a residential building, a famous photo spot.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: Chongqing's central pedestrian shopping district with a landmark monument.
placeDesc.Hongyadong: A stilted riverside building complex in Chongqing, famous for its night view.
